universe.rule: Historical S&P 500 members in May 2022 snapshot

fundamentals.causalRule: Use FY2021 only; because fiscal year ended during 2021, standard 10-K filing deadlines place publication before 2022-05-03; this is conservative for issuers with newer FY2022 data already public.
fundamentals.debtEquity: FY2021 total debt / FY2021 positive total equity
fundamentals.earningsVariability: sample stddev of 4 YoY EPS growth rates from FY2017-FY2021 diluted EPS
fundamentals.missingRule: ROE required; D/E or EVAR may be missing singly; both missing excludes
fundamentals.highQualityRule: score >= cross-sectional median among profitable evaluable companies

valuation.descriptor: FY2021 diluted EPS / raw close on 2022-05-03
valuation.cheapReasonableRule: earnings yield >= median within high Quality
valuation.expensiveRule: earnings yield < median within high Quality

primaryGate.rule: cheap/reasonable mean return > expensive mean return AND cheap mean excess positive vs SPY and URTH AND expensive mean excess negative vs SPY and URTH

secondaryGuardDiagnostic.rule: Most-expensive valuation quartile inside high Quality underperforms remaining 75% in mean return; Q1 mean excess must be negative vs SPY and URTH. This is confirmation-only for the extreme-expensive penalty observed in R1, not a production policy.
